content.subtitle: Mermaid: flowchart
content.diagram_html:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
    <defs>
        <script type="application/mermaid+json">{
            "code": "flowchart TD
    A["Customer places order online"]
    B["System validates payment method"]
    C["Payment processor authorizes transaction"]
    D["Inventory system checks stock availability"]
    E["Warehouse receives picking list"]
    F["Order is packed and shipped"]
    G["Customer receives delivery confirmation"]
    H["Order marked as complete"]

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H",
            "theme": "default",
            "themeVariables": {"primaryColor": "#8B5CF6", "primaryTextColor": "#1F2937", "primaryBorderColor": "#A78BFA", "lineColor": "#A78BFA", "background": "#FFFFFF"}
        }</script>
    </defs>
    <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="400" y="300" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1F2937">
        [Mermaid Diagram - Client Render Required]
    </text>
</svg>

content.subtitle: Mermaid: erDiagram
content.diagram_html:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
    <defs>
        <script type="application/mermaid+json">{
            "code": "erDiagram
    Users {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR email
        VARCHAR name
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Orders {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR user_id FK
        DECIMAL total_amount
        VARCHAR status
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Products {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR name
        VARCHAR description
        DECIMAL price
        INT stock_quantity
    }

    OrderItems {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR order_id FK
        VARCHAR product_id FK
        INT quantity
        DECIMAL unit_price
    }

    Reviews {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR user_id FK
        VARCHAR product_id FK
        INT rating
        VARCHAR comment
    }

    Categories {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR name
        VARCHAR parent_id FK
    }

    ProductCategories {
        VARCHAR product_id FK
        VARCHAR category_id FK
    }

    Users ||--o{ Orders : "places"
    Orders ||--o{ OrderItems : "contains"
    Products ||--o{ OrderItems : "included in"
    Users ||--o{ Reviews : "writes"
    Products ||--o{ Reviews : "has"
    Categories ||--o{ Categories : "has sub-categories"
    Products ||--o{ ProductCategories : "categorized in"
    Categories ||--o{ ProductCategories : "contains products"}",
            "theme": "default",
            "themeVariables": {"primaryColor": "#8B5CF6", "primaryTextColor": "#1F2937", "primaryBorderColor": "#A78BFA", "lineColor": "#A78BFA", "background": "#FFFFFF"}
        }</script>
    </defs>
    <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="400" y="300" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1F2937">
        [Mermaid Diagram - Client Render Required]
    </text>
</svg>

content.subtitle: Mermaid: kanban
content.diagram_html:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
    <defs>
        <script type="application/mermaid+json">{
            "code": "flowchart LR
    subgraph backlog["Backlog"]
        task1["User authentication improvements"]
        task2["Payment gateway integration"]
        task3["Mobile app notifications"]
    end
    
    subgraph inprogress["In Progress"]
        task4["Dashboard redesign"]
        task5["API performance optimization"]
    end
    
    subgraph inreview["In Review"]
        task6["Search functionality upgrade"]
        task7["Email template system"]
    end
    
    subgraph done["Done"]
        task8["Database migration"]
        task9["Security audit fixes"]
        task10["Documentation update"]
    end
    
    backlog ~~~ inprogress
    inprogress ~~~ inreview
    inreview ~~~ done",
            "theme": "default",
            "themeVariables": {"primaryColor": "#8B5CF6", "primaryTextColor": "#1F2937", "primaryBorderColor": "#A78BFA", "lineColor": "#A78BFA", "background": "#FFFFFF"}
